q.line: Knocked him down, stood on his chest with one foot
q.linePrev: And beat him over the head with it 'til I broke the wood
q.lineNext: Made it home later that same day

partner.line: And beat him over the head with it 'til I broke the wood

stanza: He swung his hammer brown and silver
Every time he closed his eyes a nail was drove
Like a splinter in the wood
He couldn't pull you from his heels
